cards.ex: It's pouring down outside; I'm soaked!
cards.exUz: Tashqarida jala quyapti; men butunlay ho'lman!

cards.ex: The weather should clear up by this afternoon.
cards.exUz: Ob-havo bugun tushdan keyin ochilishi kerak.

cards.ex: We're having a heatwave this week; it's unbearable!
cards.exUz: Bu hafta issiq to'lqini bo'lyapti; chidab bo'lmaydi!
cards.uzDef: Juda issiq, odatdagidan yuqori harorat davri.

cards.ex: It's below freezing tonight; be careful of ice.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun muzlashdan past; muzdan ehtiyot bo'ling.

cards.ex: There's a light breeze today, perfect for sailing.
cards.exUz: Bugun engil shabada esmoqda, suzish uchun a'lo.

cards.ex: There's thick fog this morning; drive carefully.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab qalin tuman; ehtiyot bo'ling.

cards.ex: Watch out for patchy ice on the roads.
cards.exUz: Yo'llarda muz qatlamlariga e'tibor bering.
cards.uzDef: Yo'llarda yoki boshqa sirtlarda muz qatlamlari.

cards.ex: The forecast is for severe weather tonight.
cards.exUz: Ob-havo bashorati bugun kechqurun og'ir ob-havoni ko'rsatmoqda.

cards.ex: We got caught in a downpour on the way home.
cards.exUz: Uyga qaytayotganda to'fonga tushib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida yog'adigan kuchli yomg'ir.

cards.ex: We had a sunny spell this afternoon.
cards.exUz: Bugun tushdan keyin quyoshli kunlar bo'ldi.

cards.ex: Climate change is a serious global issue.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi jiddiy global muammo.

cards.ex: Global warming is causing sea levels to rise.
cards.exUz: Global isish dengiz sathining ko'tarilishiga olib kelmoqda.

cards.ex: The greenhouse effect traps heat in the atmosphere.
cards.exUz: Issiqxona effekti atmosferada issiqlikni ushlab qoladi.

cards.ex: We should reduce our carbon footprint.
cards.exUz: Biz uglerod izimizni kamaytirishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: We've been having some freak weather lately.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi paytlarda bizda g'alati ob-havo bo'lyapti.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
cards.exUz: Bugun o'zimni biroz kasalmand his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, biroz kasal bo'lish.

cards.ex: Hopefully, the sun will chase away the clouds.
cards.exUz: Umid qilamanki, quyosh bulutlarni haydab yuboradi.

cards.ex: We'll weather the storm and come out stronger.
cards.exUz: Biz qiyinchilikni yengib, undan kuchliroq bo'lib chiqamiz.

cards.ex: I lost my job, and then my car broke down; it never rains but it pours!
cards.exUz: Men ishimni yo'qotdim, keyin mashinam buzildi; kulfat ustiga kulfat!
cards.term: it never rains but it pours
cards.uzDef: Bir qiyinchilik ortidan boshqa qiyinchiliklar kelishi.

cards.ex: We're expecting a cold snap next week.
cards.exUz: Keyingi hafta sovuq urishini kutmoqdamiz.

cards.ex: The farmers are worried about the dry spell.
cards.exUz: Fermerlar qurg'oqchilikdan xavotirda.

cards.ex: The new play took the theater world by storm.
cards.exUz: Yangi pyesa teatr olamini zabt etdi.

cards.ex: It's raining cats and dogs outside!
cards.exUz: Tashqarida bo'ron yomg'ir yog'yapti!

cards.ex: I got caught in a thunderstorm yesterday.
cards.exUz: Kecha momaqaldiroqda tutilib qoldim.

cards.ex: The snowdrifts are blocking the road.
cards.exUz: Qor uyumlari yo'lni to'sib qo'ydi.

cards.ex: We saw a flurry of snow this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab qor parchalari yog'ishini ko'rdik.

cards.ex: The hailstorm damaged our car.
cards.exUz: Do'l yog'ishi mashinamizga zarar yetkazdi.

cards.ex: Temperatures have been above average this summer.
cards.exUz: Bu yozda harorat o'rtachadan yuqori bo'ldi.

cards.ex: Rainfall has been below average this year.
cards.exUz: Yomg'ir yog'ishi bu yil o'rtachadan past bo'ldi.

cards.ex: It's been raining on and off all day.
cards.exUz: Butun kun davomida vaqti-vaqti bilan yomg'ir yog'di.
